# Retry / Backoff / Attempt Map — preloop (`/tmp/preloop-deploy-build`, branch `fix/pool-recovery-fixes`)

Read-only survey of every retry/backoff/attempt/poll site in the five target crates. Tests and `#[cfg(test)]` blocks excluded. Line numbers refer to the worktree at `/tmp/preloop-deploy-build`.

Legend: exp = exponential backoff, jittered = random within a band, fixed = constant sleep, bounded = attempt cap or deadline, unbounded = no cap (ends only on success/shutdown/process exit).

---

## crates/preloop-runner-server/src (control plane)

| site | what | policy | bounded? |
|---|---|---|---|
| github.rs:171-183 `resolve_check_run_token` | GitHub App check-run token mint (transient 422) | `for attempt in 0..2` (2 attempts), fixed 500ms sleep between; any non-first error → break | yes (2 attempts) |
| github.rs:946-1012 `handle_github_webhook` | GitHub webhook redelivery dedup | No preloop retry: reservation released on failure so **GitHub's** redelivery is accepted; Completed dedup window 300s (WEBHOOK_DEDUP_WINDOW) | n/a (coordination with GitHub's retry, window-bounded) |
| github_app.rs:677-721 `mint_for_repository` | App installation token mint rejected with 422 (ungranted scope) | Single re-mint with permission set clamped to installation grants (one retry variant, no loop) | yes (1 re-mint) |
| store.rs:845-866 `checkpoint_wal` | SQLite `PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)` blocked (busy=1) | `for _ in 0..10` (10 attempts), fixed 10ms `std::thread::sleep` (blocking), then `bail!` | yes (10 attempts ≈100ms) |
| debug.rs:83-96 `pump_axum_ws_to_dap` | WebSocket connect to runner DAP bridge | `for _ in 0..50` (50 attempts), fixed 200ms sleep → ≤10s | yes (50 attempts) |
| snapshots.rs:1571-1601 `acquire_cache_lock` | Snapshot object-cache directory lock (AlreadyExists) | `loop {}` with 25ms sleep; stale lock (>60s mtime) force-removed; hard deadline 10s → ApiError | yes (10s deadline) |
| broker.rs:539-624 `next_message_broker_ref_root` | Broker job-claim long poll | `loop {}` until deadline `now + wait` (default 50s); wakes on `message_notify` in ≤3s slices (`slice = remaining.min(3s)`); no sleep on busy path | yes (deadline = wait secs) |
| broker.rs:228-303 `next_message_broker_ref` | Broker job-claim long poll (plaintext path) | `loop {}` with `tokio::time::timeout(wait_seconds, notified)` then `continue`; default wait 50s | yes (wait secs) |
| distributed_task.rs:28-103 `next_message` | AzDO message long poll (claim) | Same `loop {}` + `timeout(wait_seconds, notified)` + `continue`; default 50s | yes (wait secs) |
| debug_sessions.rs:1030-1076 `poll_verdict` | Worker verdict long poll | `loop {}` with `sleep_until(deadline)`, wait ≤ VERDICT_POLL_MAX (25s); also mints fresh snapshot token on Retry verdict | yes (25s cap) |
| debug_sessions.rs:1198-1225 `agent_events` | Agent structured-events long poll | `loop {}` + `sleep_until(deadline)`, wait ≤ VERDICT_POLL_MAX (25s) | yes (25s cap) |
| bootstrap.rs:396-407 `run_background_reaper` | Periodic sweep re-checking stalled jobs/sessions | `tokio::time::interval(10s)`; runs until shutdown (time-unbounded but periodic, not failure-triggered) | unbounded in wall time (per-process) |
| runtime_scheduling.rs:714-716 (inside promotion pass) | Concurrency-blocked job re-queued | Job put back into pending queue; retried by next release event or `promote_ready_jobs` sweep (retry-by-requeue, no sleep) | unbounded (event/sweep driven) |
| runtime_scheduling.rs:567-597 `advance_jobset_admission` | Admission-gate acquisition loop | `loop {}` over gates, no sleep (blocked → return; not a failure retry) | yes (finite gates) |
| actions.rs:37-53 `sha_entry_fresh` + state.rs:297-302 | Action ref→SHA resolution failures | Negative result cached 60s (ACTION_SHA_NEGATIVE_TTL), positive 300s; re-attempt happens on next dispatch after TTL — rate-limits retries, no loop | yes (TTL-bounded) |
| broker.rs:691-705 `broker_acquire_job_root` | Dispatch GitHub token mint refusal at claim | **Deliberately no retry**: config fault under `error` policy; job failed terminally (`fail_unclaimable_request`) instead of re-queued | n/a |
| runner_lifecycle.rs / dispatch.rs / state.rs | — | No retry/backoff sites (persist is single-shot; state is in-memory) | — |

## crates/preloop-orchestrator/src (runner pool / golden management)

| site | what | policy | bounded? |
|---|---|---|---|
| lib.rs:2468-2487 `run_on_demand` (slot supervisor) | Re-spawning failed runner slots | Exponential: 500ms → `saturating_mul(2).min(30s)` cap; **reset to ZERO on any success**; sleeps only after failures | attempts unbounded (process lifetime), per-sleep ≤30s |
| lib.rs:3187-3196 `run_on_demand_slot` (provision failure) | Provisioning a runner (fork/create) failed | Fixed 500ms sleep + `continue` outer loop; no counter, no escalation | **unbounded attempts** (runs until success/shutdown) |
| lib.rs:3698-3728 `provision_runner` | Re-arm spent golden after live-clone drain | `for attempt in 0..12` with GOLDEN_DRAIN_PROBE_DELAY (10s) sleep → up to ~120s; then fallback to direct OCI creation | yes (12 attempts) |
| lib.rs:1373-1388 `await_guest_ready` | Guest agent readiness probe (`exec true`) | `loop {}` with 25ms poll (GUEST_READY_POLL) until GUEST_READY_TIMEOUT (30s deadline) | yes (30s deadline) |
| lib.rs:361-470 `download_prebaked_golden` / 554+ `download_oci_golden` | Golden release/OCI download | Single attempt; reqwest client timeout GOLDEN_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT = **1h**; failure → warn + fall back to local build (no retry) | n/a (single shot, 1h timeout) |
| lib.rs:1897-1899 `preload_images` (embedded shell) | Wait for dockerd readiness before image pull | `for _ in $(seq 1 150); do docker info && break; sleep 0.2; done` → 150 × 0.2s = 30s bound; image pulls themselves single-shot (`preload miss` logged) | yes (30s) |
| lib.rs:1336-1350 `docker_start_command` (embedded shell) | dockerd start: readiness + kill-wait + one retry | `start_dockerd` polls 50 × 0.2s (10s) for ready; on fail kills and polls 25 × 0.2s (5s) for death; wipes data-root and retries `start_dockerd` once (2 attempts total) | yes (2 attempts, 10s/5s polls) |
| lib.rs:2405-2408 `run_on_demand` (queued-wait) | Wait for queued job count > 0 | `loop {}` polling `pending_jobs` every 50ms, cancellable; not a failure retry | unbounded but shutdown-cancellable |
| keys.rs:195-206 (test helper only) | Refill-keypair wait | 60s `timeout` wrapper around 50ms poll loop (test-only) | n/a (test) |

## crates/preloop-vm/src (smolvm provider)

| site | what | policy | bounded? |
|---|---|---|---|
| lib.rs:970-1005 `delete` | `smolvm machine delete` retry | `loop {}` with `attempts` counter; max 3 attempts: "directory not empty" → 100ms sleep, "database is locked" → 500ms sleep; "not found" treated as success (idempotent); other errors break immediately | yes (3 attempts) |

Fork/create/exec/start/stop have **no retry** — errors propagate to the orchestrator, which retries at the slot level.

## crates/preloop-runner/src (runner binary)

| site | what | policy | bounded? |
|---|---|---|---|
| client/http.rs:283-331 `post_json_with_auth` | HTTP POST (AzDO/broker JSON) | `for attempt in 0..3`; backoff `1 << attempt` = 2s, 4s; retries only transient 5xx or network errors (is_transient_status); non-transient status returns immediately | yes (3 attempts) |
| client/http.rs:484-522 `put_json_with_auth` | HTTP PUT JSON | Same: 3 attempts, 2s/4s exp, transient only | yes (3 attempts) |
| client/http.rs:532-558 `put_bytes_bearer` | HTTP PUT bytes (log append) | Same: 3 attempts, 2s/4s exp | yes (3 attempts) |
| client/http.rs:19-40 `SessionBackoff::next_delay` (+ `reset`) | Listener session/poll reconnect backoff | Jittered bands mirroring official MessageListener.cs: consecutive errors ≤5 → `[15,30)s`, >5 → `[30,60)s`; `reset()` on success | attempts unbounded; per-sleep 15-60s |
| listener/broker_listener.rs:233-386, 726-767 `run_broker_loop` | Session creation + message poll (broker path) | SessionBackoff (15-60s jittered), reset on success; 409 conflict retriable with same backoff; OAuth re-acquire failure → linear `min(consecutive_errors*5, 60)`s (cap 60s); deprecated-version error → exit | **unbounded attempts** (until shutdown) |
| listener/message_listener.rs:48-76 `run` (session creation) | Session create: 409 conflict / transient error | Conflict: `conflict_retries` cap **8**, fixed 30s sleep → ~4min cap; transient: fixed 30s sleep, **no cap** | conflict: yes (8); transient: **unbounded** |
| listener/message_listener.rs:99-218 `run` (poll loop) | Message long-poll errors | SessionBackoff (15-60s jittered), reset on success | **unbounded attempts** (until shutdown) |
| worker/container_ops.rs:600-639 `wait_for_services_healthy` | Docker service health poll | Exponential: delay = `min(2 + (2^attempt − 1)*2, 32)`s (official GetExponentialBackoff, min 2s, max 32s, delta 2s); **no retry cap** — only outer job timeout/cancel terminates | **unbounded attempts** |
| worker/container_ops.rs:799-834 `docker_registry_login` | `docker login` for private registries | `for attempt in 0..3`; backoff 5s, 10s (`5 * 2^(attempt−1)`) | yes (3 attempts) |
| worker/debug_pause.rs:33-34, 396-411 `await_verdict` | Debug-verdict poll after transport error | `loop {}`; POLL_BACKOFF fixed 2s on error; 404 (session gone) → resume; **loops indefinitely by design** (server suspends job timeout while session open) | **unbounded by design** |
| worker/live_logs.rs:31, 255-266 `send` | Live-log WebSocket send | `for attempt in 0..RETRIES` (RETRIES=3), random backoff 100-500ms (`random_backoff`), reconnect between attempts | yes (3 attempts) |
| worker/live_logs.rs:284-317 `connect` | Live-log WebSocket connect | `for attempt in 0..RETRIES` (3), CONNECT_TIMEOUT 30s per dial, random 100-500ms backoff | yes (3 attempts) |
| worker/steps_runner.rs:126, 587-1014 `run_steps` | Debug retry loop (`:retry` / `retry --from` verdicts) | Retry loop per step capped at MAX_DEBUG_ATTEMPTS = **25**; then step fails + `debugging_declined` (never pauses again); journal cloned server-side otherwise unbounded | yes (25 attempts) |
| worker/job_runner.rs:1105-1164 `first_renew_gate` | First `renewjob` before any step runs | `loop {}`; FIRST_RENEW_RETRY_LIMIT = **5**; random 1-10s backoff (official band); 404 → Abandoned immediately | yes (5 retries ≈ ≤60s) |
| worker/job_runner.rs:884-958, 1063-1074, 1220-1232 `spawn_renew_loop` + `renew_backoff` | Steady-state job lease renewal (every 60s) | Failures: random 5-15s (first 5), 15-30s (after); exhausted when `now > LockedUntil + 5min` (`lease_expired`) or ≥5 failures with no deadline; 401 → re-acquire token + immediate retry once; 404 → lease lost, cancel job | yes (lease window + 5min grace) |
| worker/reporting.rs:64-83 `flush_step_updates` | Timeline/WorkflowStepsUpdate publish | Failure → `requeue_steps`; retried on next 500ms drain tick (`job_runner.rs:478-486`); no attempt counter | **unbounded attempts** (per-tick, until job ends) |
| worker/job_dispatcher.rs:415-443 `confirm_completion` | Wait for worker completion ack | `loop {}` 5ms sleep, 500ms SETTLE deadline (wait, not retry) | yes (500ms) |
| worker/process.rs:170-210 | Stream-drain wait before kill | 100ms sleep ticks until STREAM_DRAIN_GRACE (5s) deadline (wait, not retry) | yes (5s) |
| control_bridge.rs:196-233 `spawn` | TCP splice to upstream (poll bridge) | Accept loop never exits; splice failure counted (warn at UPSTREAM_FAILURE_WARN_THRESHOLD), bridge **stays up** — the runner's own poll loop retries forever through it; no backoff in the bridge itself | architecture-level retry-forever |

## crates/preloop-runner-client/src (CLI submit client)

| site | what | policy | bounded? |
|---|---|---|---|
| — (none) | CLI has no retry loops | reqwest client timeout only (main.rs:99-102, `timeout_seconds`); single-shot submits | n/a |

---

## GAPS — dangerous sites

### 1. Unbounded retries (no attempt cap)

| file:line | what | backoff | why it matters |
|---|---|---|---|
| preloop-runner/src/worker/container_ops.rs:600-639 `wait_for_services_healthy` | Docker health poll | exp 2→32s, no cap | A stuck `starting` container polls forever; only outer job timeout (could be hours) ends it. Delay per attempt caps at 32s, but the loop itself never gives up. |
| preloop-runner/src/worker/debug_pause.rs:396-411 `await_verdict` | verdict poll | fixed 2s | Infinite by design (server suspends timeout) — but a wedged server = permanent poll with 2s chatter. |
| preloop-runner/src/listener/broker_listener.rs:233-386, 726-767 | session + poll errors | 15-60s jittered | Retries forever until shutdown; acceptable only because sleep is long. |
| preloop-runner/src/listener/message_listener.rs:99-218 (and transient session-create path at 70-76) | poll errors / transient session errors | 15-60s / fixed 30s | Retries forever until shutdown; 30s fixed on transient session errors. |
| preloop-runner/src/worker/reporting.rs:64-83 `flush_step_updates` | timeline publish | retried every 500ms tick | A permanently failing publish endpoint = a step update flushed every 500ms forever (log/CPU churn; requeue re-dirties forever). |
| preloop-orchestrator/src/lib.rs:3187-3196 | runner provisioning failure | fixed 500ms | Unbounded 500ms tight-ish retry; a broken smolvm spins at 2 attempts/s (the slot-supervisor exp backoff above it does NOT apply to this inner loop). |
| preloop-orchestrator/src/lib.rs:2468-2487 | slot respawn failure | exp 500ms→30s cap | Attempts unbounded for pool lifetime; delay capped at 30s so log storm is bounded. |
| preloop-runner/src/control_bridge.rs:196-233 | upstream splice failures | none (bridge stays up) | By design: runner's poll loop retries forever through the bridge; a dead upstream = permanent connect-refused churn at the runner's poll cadence. |

### 2. Tight loops with no/insufficient backoff (all are bounded or non-failure, noted)

- **store.rs:863** `checkpoint_wal` — 10ms sleep × 10 (bounded ~100ms; blocking `std::thread::sleep` inside async path).
- **snapshots.rs:1600** `acquire_cache_lock` — 25ms poll, 10s deadline (bounded).
- **lib.rs:1385 (orchestrator)** `await_guest_ready` — 25ms poll, 30s deadline (bounded).
- **job_dispatcher.rs:441** `confirm_completion` — 5ms poll, 500ms deadline (bounded; test/teardown path).
- **lib.rs:2405-2408 (orchestrator)** queued-job wait — 50ms poll, shutdown-cancellable (not a failure retry).
- **broker.rs:620-622** — 3s notify slices; bounded by claim deadline.
- No pure busy-spin retry loops found (every failure retry sleeps ≥2s, except provision 500ms and WAL 10ms).

### 3. Long sleeps / long single waits

- **runner SessionBackoff (http.rs:27-34)**: 15-30s, then 30-60s per failure — worst case sustained interval 60s.
- **message_listener.rs:62-75**: fixed 30s per retry; conflict path bounded at 8 retries ≈ 4min, transient path unbounded.
- **job_runner.rs:1232 `renew_backoff`**: 15-30s per failure; renew window = LockedUntil + **5min grace** (job_runner.rs:1241 `lease_expired`).
- **container_ops.rs:630**: 32s max per health-poll attempt, unbounded attempts.
- **orchestrator lib.rs:3700**: golden drain probe 10s × 12 = up to **2min** before fallback.
- **orchestrator lib.rs:299 GOLDEN_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT = 1h** (single attempt; then local-build fallback — a very long one-shot, not a retry).
- **broker.rs / distributed_task.rs**: claim long-poll default 50s (bounded by design).
- **debug_sessions.rs VERDICT_POLL_MAX 25s** per long-poll; worker re-polls immediately (not additive).
- **live_logs.rs**: 30s connect timeout × 3 attempts + up to 500ms backoff ≈ up to ~91s before falling back to blob logs.

### Notable deliberate non-retries
- **broker.rs:691-705**: dispatch-token mint refusal under `error` policy is failed terminally — "no retry can clear" a config fault.
- **job_runner.rs:924** renew 404 → immediate Abandoned (lease genuinely lost).
- **github.rs:946-1012** webhook: relies on GitHub redelivery instead of in-process retry.
- **orchestrator golden download**: fails over to a local build rather than re-downloading.

---

## One-line retry philosophy

> **Server: retry-once-and-coordinate** — the control plane avoids in-process retry loops almost entirely (a single 500ms token-mint retry, a 10×10ms SQLite checkpoint, 50×200ms DAP bridge dial), instead leaning on GitHub redelivery, runner long-polls (bounded by `waitSeconds`), and 10s reaper sweeps; **Runner: mirror-the-official-runner** — bounded P1.7-style 3-attempt exponential HTTP retries, jittered SessionBackoff (15-60s) reset on success, bounded lease-renewal windows, but listener/session loops and the container-health poll retry **forever** by design; **Pool: retry-forever with exponential damping** — slot respawns back off 500ms→30s cap with success reset, provisioning retries fixed-500ms unbounded, golden re-arm bounded (12×10s) before fallback; **VM: tiny bounded delete-only retry** (3 attempts, 100/500ms).
